endorsements.name: Brad Antoniewicz
endorsements.label: The Safety Dance - Wardriving the Public Safety Band
endorsements.description: The 4.9Ghz Public Safety Band has been deployed to a town near you! Police, Emergency Medical, and even Critical Infrastructure (power plants, etc.) maintain wireless networks on this seemingly ‘hidden’ band – but what’s actually there? How can you identify and monitor these networks? Stop by and find out the answers to those questions and more!
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
